text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
Come and get it! Come and get it! We're
offering fresh deals on the
freshest carrots
around!

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text: And as an extra bonus, buyers will get to join the Team Sirius! Get 'em while they're still here!

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text: Are we sure this will attract new members?

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text:
Doing nothing at all might work better
than this...

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text:
But we need to be proactive here!
Otherwise the other teams might
get all
the good students!

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text:
And Brian, if you keep scowling like that,
you're gonna scare people
away.

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text: This is just my face.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Numerous new students don their uniforms
and cross through the
school gates for the
first time today.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
On their faces is a mix of hope and
fear as
each of them takes their
first steps down
this new path.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
But in all of their eyes,
I see nothing but
dreams.

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
Trainer! I put up all the posters you gave
me!

text_block_list.name: Sincere Umamusume
text_block_list.text: All our posters are up too!

text_block_list.name: Caring Umamusume
text_block_list.text:
There's some at the gates, the dorm
cafeteria, and every last
classroom.

text_block_list.name: Upbeat Umamusume
text_block_list.text:
This should help us find new teammates in
no time!

text_block_list.name: <username>
text_block_list.text:
Not that we really need to find any. We've
got more than enough
members to remain
active.

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
Well, yeah, but when we talked about it,
we all said we wanted to see
Team Sirius
spread its message even further!

text_block_list.name: <username>
text_block_list.text:
Wait a second... why are you wearing your
racewear?

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
Huh? Actually, I wanted to ask why you
guys aren't wearing yours.
Didn't Gold
Ship tell you we were meeting in our
racewear?

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text:
I meeean, you're the best racer in Japan!
Seeing you race around is
sure to grab
everyone's attention!

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text: Oh, I... think that makes sense?

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text:
All right, Spe! As our Team Sirius
Ambassador, show 'em your run—no,
your
Team Sirius spirit!

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text: O-okay!

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text: Hehe, running really does suit her best.

text_block_list.name: <username>
text_block_list.text: ...It really does.

text_block_list.name: <username>
text_block_list.text: ...It really does.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Umamusume run with a dream in their
sights.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
It is the job of her trainer and her
teammates to help her reach that
dream.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
And once that dream comes true, it
becomes the link to the next
dreamer.

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
Come on, everyone! Let's spend our school
days together!

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
And together, we'll bring your dream to
life!
